data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: application
sections.summary: an official request, usually written, for a job, course, or service

senses.definition: a formal (often written) request for something, such as a job, course, or permission

answers.answer: She submitted her application online.
She applied her application online.
Application is a meeting with the manager.

sections.question: autobiography
sections.summary: a book someone writes about their own life

senses.definition: a book or text that a person writes about their own life
examples: He wrote an autobiography about his childhood.

answers.answer: He wrote an autobiography about his childhood.
He wrote an autobiography by his teacher.
An autobiography is a driving document.

sections.question: biography
sections.summary: a book about someone’s life, written by another person

senses.definition: a book or text about a person’s life, written by someone else
examples: She read a biography of Nelson Mandela.

answers.answer: She read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
She biographied Nelson Mandela last week.
A biography is an official passport.

sections.question: candidate
sections.summary: a person being considered for a job, position, or election

senses.definition: a person who is being considered for a job or chosen for a position (including an election)

answers.answer: Each candidate was interviewed carefully.
Each candidate interviewed the company.
A candidate is the person who gives the job.

sections.question: certificate
sections.summary: an official document that proves something is true or completed

senses.definition: an official document that proves something, such as completion, qualification, or identity
examples: She received a certificate after completing the course.

answers.answer: She received a certificate after completing the course.
She certificated the course yesterday.
A certificate is a short conversation.

sections.question: document
sections.summary: a piece of paper or file that gives information or proof

senses.definition: a written or electronic piece of information, often used as proof or a record
examples: Please upload the document as a PDF file.

answers.answer: Please upload the document as a PDF file.
Please document your passport at the airport.
A document is a type of interview.

sections.question: driver's license
sections.summary: an official card that allows you to drive a vehicle

senses.definition: an official document/card that shows you are allowed to drive a vehicle
examples: You must carry your driver's license when driving.

answers.answer: You must carry your driver's license when driving.
You must license your driver before travel.
A driver's license is used to vote in elections.

sections.question: form
sections.summary: a document with spaces to fill in information

senses.definition: a document with questions or boxes where you write information
examples: Please fill in the form before the interview.

answers.answer: Please fill in the form before the interview.
Please fill the form on before interview.
A form is a type of autobiography.

sections.question: identification
sections.summary: official proof of who you are (for example, a passport or ID card)

senses.definition: official proof of who someone is (for example, an ID card, passport, or driving licence)
examples: You need identification to enter the building.

answers.answer: You need identification to enter the building.
You need identify to enter the building.
Identification is a school subject.

sections.question: initial
sections.summary: the first letter of a name (often written as a short signature)

senses.definition: the first letter of a name; often written instead of the full name, especially on documents
examples: Please write your initial next to your signature.

answers.answer: Please write your initial next to your signature.
Please initial your full name completely.
Initial is another word for passport.
